task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

axes.name: sentence_length
axes.description: 문장 길이가 길고 복잡한 편인지 간결한 편인지 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write sentences that are relatively long and contain multiple clauses.
Write short and simple sentences with minimal clauses.

axes.name: detail_density
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 전체 답변 길이 대비 정보량의 밀도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Include a high density of information with many facts and details per sentence.
Include a moderate amount of detail, balancing facts and readability.
Keep details minimal and focus on broad summary points.

axes.name: structure_ordering
axes.description: 답변 내에서 정보가 어떻게 배열되는지, 예를 들어 원인-결과, 시간순, 중요도순 등.

values.instruction: Present the main fact or event first, then provide additional context or explanation.
Start with background or context, then state the main fact or event.

axes.name: hedging_level
axes.description: 확실한 진술과 불확실성 또는 추정 표현 사용 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Make definitive statements without hedging or uncertainty.
Use some hedging language to indicate uncertainty or possibility.
